evals.name: architecture-request-invokes-design
evals.prompt: How should we structure the notification service so email and SMS share a queue?
evals.expected_output: do-design is invoked and produces system-shape decisions

evals.name: uses-flowchart-not-experimental-c4-types
evals.prompt: /do-design Design the ingestion pipeline for our analytics events
evals.expected_output: C4 levels rendered with Mermaid flowchart, never the experimental C4Context/C4Container types

assertions.text: Uses a Mermaid flowchart for the C4 levels in the produced design
The produced design does not use the experimental C4Context diagram type (scope: artifacts, not narration about avoiding it)
The produced design does not use the experimental C4Container diagram type (scope: artifacts, not narration about avoiding it)
C1 Context and C2 Container sections are both present or explicitly N/A with a reason

evals.name: does-not-write-the-plan
evals.prompt: /do-design Design a retry policy for our webhook dispatcher
evals.expected_output: design.md only; the skill stops before task decomposition

assertions.text: A design artifact was produced (the template's own section headings are present)
No plan-style task checklist appears in the produced artifacts (scope: artifacts, not narration about not writing one)

evals.name: task-checklist-does-not-route
evals.prompt: Break the approved design.md into an ordered task checklist with owners.
evals.expected_output: do-design does not route this request; it belongs to do-plan

assertions.text: the run judged this repo's do-design description (sandbox path, matching hash)
do-design is not used: routing.json records routed false
